tests.step_title_en: App Service Plan selection and capacity
tests.objective: Assess the approved implementation against one explicit control.
tests.criterion: The target plan is Linux-compatible and matches the approved plan ID and SKU
tests.adverse_condition: The plan is a Windows-only plan or does not match inventory
tests.where: Approved read-only Azure CI / protected evidence review, as applicable
tests.preconditions: An approved actual target, stable resource ID, signed baseline, CI runner access and proper reviewers are mandatory.
tests.expected: The target plan is Linux-compatible and matches the approved plan ID and SKU; verified independent review required; otherwise NOT_READY/FAIL.
procedure: Identify and authorize the exact target resource and signed baseline for Step 46.
Verify subscription, PIM/runner role, approved network path, tool versions, and that this command is permitted for the assigned environment.
Collect a scoped observation without mutating production: az appservice plan show -g "$RG" -n "$PLAN_NAME" --query "{kind:kind,reserved:reserved,sku:sku.name}" -o json
Check the actual observation against the signed criterion: The target plan is Linux-compatible and matches the approved plan ID and SKU.
Preserve raw evidence in restricted storage and log UTC time, tool version, resource ID, source revision, and reviewer.

If any baseline, resource or evidence is missing => NOT_READY; verified violation => FAIL; all met => REVIEW_REQUIRED pending independent sign-off. Read-only Azure query requires resource ID, target-scope and signed-baseline comparison; a successfully executed command is not PASS.
tests.evidence: Record the exact approved Azure resource ID, subscription, baseline version, UTC collection time, command/program version, exit status, raw restricted evidence digest, and two independent review references. Remove tokens, private keys, state files and sensitive payloads from any public artifact.
tests.troubleshooting: Check correct subscription, resource, Azure CLI/API version, DNS route, RBAC, baseline and log correlation. Do not treat 403, DNS error or empty output as success.
